01

“and bound them to the word of righteousness”

Three explanations transmitted from ʿAlī and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 48:26).

896
Explanation from ʿAlī No. 896: 1

ʿAlī

English
Transmission wording
896: 1. Sufyan, from Salama ibn Kuhayl, from Ubaba ibn Ribi, from Ali, on His words
"and bound them to the word of righteousness": He said, there is no god but God, and God is greatest (verse 26).
العربية
896: 1 سفيان عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ عَنْ عُبَابَةَ بْنِ رِبْعِيٍّ عَنْ عَلِيّ فِي قَوْلِهِ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ التَّقْوَى قَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ والله أكبر (الآية 26) .

897
Report from Mujāhid No. 897: 2

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
897: 2. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Mujahid, who said:
There is no god but God.
العربية
897: 2 سفيان عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ لا إله الا الله.

898
Report No. 898: 3

Report 898

English
898: 3. Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from Amr ibn Maymun, the same.

898: 3 سفيان عن أبي اسحق عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ مِثْلِهِ.

02

“their mark is on their faces”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 48:29).

899
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 899: 4

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
899: 4. Sufyan, from Humayd al-Araj, from Mujahid, on His words
"their mark is on their faces": He said, humility and lowliness (verse 29).
العربية
899: 4 سفيان عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ قال الخشوع والتواضع (الآية 29) .
Edition record 371517 · p. 278Link to report ↗
900
Report from Mujāhid No. 900: 5

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
900: 5. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Mujahid, who said:
It is humility.
العربية
900: 5 سفيان عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ هو الخشوع
